label: Website Team
blurb: A Website Lead with design, writing, building, search and testing
purpose: For a business that needs a new website or a better one. The lead keeps the scope clear; the team designs the pages, writes the words, builds it, makes it findable and tests it before launch.

project.name: Website
project.goal: Launch a clear, fast website that turns visitors into customers.

members.title: Website Lead
members.name: Nadia
focus: Own the site plan and the launch checklist.

members.title: Web Designer
members.name: Felix
focus: Design each page mobile-first from the site plan.

members.title: Web Copywriter
members.name: Zoe
focus: Write every page's words, headline first.

members.title: Web Developer
members.name: Arjun
focus: Build the pages on a staging copy and fix what testing finds.

members.title: SEO Specialist
members.name: Lucia
focus: Set each page's search terms, titles and descriptions.

members.title: Website Tester
